subject: general
question: Which Article of Indian Constitution speaks about official languages of Indian Union?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Art. 343**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 343(1)** of the Constitution provides that Hindi in Devanagari script shall be the Official Language of the Union.
 
• **Article 343(2)** also provided for continuing the use of English in the official work of the Union for a period of 15 years from the date of commencement of the Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Art. 341**
 
 
 
• The President may concerning any State or Union territory, and after consultation with the Governor thereof, by public notification, specify the castes, races or tribes or parts of or groups within castes, races or tribes which shall for this Constitution be deemed to be Scheduled Castes with that State or Union territory, as the case may be.
 
 
 
 

 **Art. 339**
 
 
 
• The President may at any time and shall, at the expiration of ten years from the commencement of this Constitution by order appoint a Commission to report on the administration of the Scheduled Areas and the welfare of the Scheduled Tribes in the States.
 
 
 
 

 **Art. 336**
 
 
 
• It provides special provision for the Anglo-Indian community in certain services.
